title: Evidence-backed portfolio foundation and first guided demo
problem: Eight independently delivered projects needed an employer entry point with traceable claims and a reproducible walkthrough.
contribution: Added an inventory tied to recorded commits and CI runs, a static showcase, a source-aligned walkthrough and explicit section gates.
ai_assistance: Codex inspected repository files, authored the foundation and draft resume, and performed local validation. Personal authorship of the underlying projects remains for owner review.
commit_note: Use the Git commit that introduces this record; no self-referential commit hash is embedded.

checks.result: eight project mappings and 25 local links passed

outcome: Locally validated foundation with five real-application demo instructions and a resume draft.

tradeoffs.cost: The working backend must run separately

tradeoffs.decision: Pin demo instructions to the recorded source commit
tradeoffs.benefit: Instructions map to preserved CI evidence
tradeoffs.cost: Future application changes require deliberate instruction and evidence updates

limitations: Docker engine was unavailable for a fresh backend run
